name: Nocturne Automatic
tagline: A midnight dial in brushed titanium.
description: The Nocturne is our quietest statement. A 41mm brushed titanium case houses a Swiss automatic movement beneath a domed sapphire crystal. The dial is lacquered in seven layers of deep black, with applied gold indices that catch the light only when you move.

name: Aurelia Tote
description: Cut from a single hide of full-grain Italian calfskin, the Aurelia is built to soften with use. Every edge is painted and burnished by hand. Inside, a suede-lined compartment holds a 14-inch laptop, with a zip pocket for the essentials.

name: Noir Absolu
tagline: Oud, black pepper, and smoked cedar.
description: A fragrance for the hour after midnight. Noir Absolu opens sharp with black pepper and bergamot, settles into a heart of Laotian oud, and dries down to smoked cedar and vetiver. Bottled in heavyweight glass with a hand-finished brass cap.

name: Sonata Over-Ear
description: Sonata is an exercise in restraint. CNC-machined aluminium arms, a lambskin headband, and 40mm beryllium drivers tuned for warmth. Active noise cancellation can be switched off entirely, so the world comes back when you want it.

name: Meridian Lamp
tagline: Hand-spun brass with a linen shade.
description: Each Meridian base is spun by hand from a single sheet of brass, then left unlacquered so it develops a patina unique to your room. The linen shade is woven in Normandy and casts a warm, low light made for late reading.

name: Solstice Chair
description: A low lounge chair with a generous seat and a gently curved back. The frame is smoked solid oak, joined without visible hardware. The bouclé is woven in the Scottish Borders from undyed wool.

name: Eclipse Sunglasses
description: A classic silhouette cut from Italian acetate and polished by hand over three days. Gold-plated hinges, mineral glass lenses, and a weight that disappears on the face. Comes with a leather case and cleaning cloth.

name: Onyx Runner
tagline: Italian nappa and a sculpted sole.
description: Our take on the everyday sneaker. Soft Italian nappa leather over a sculpted rubber sole, with a cork footbed that moulds to your step. Designed to be worn without socks and resoled for years.

name: Solitaire Band
tagline: 18k gold vermeil with a lab diamond.
description: A single brilliant-cut lab diamond set in a hand-forged band of 18k gold vermeil. Understated enough for every day, considered enough for the day it matters. Each stone is certified and traceable.

name: Ember Candle
description: Hand-poured in small batches into a reusable stoneware vessel. Ember burns for sixty hours with a clean, even flame. The scent is dry and green at first, then warm amber and vetiver as the evening settles.

name: Verano Weekender
description: A weekend bag with a soft structure and a wide opening. Vegetable-tanned leather from Tuscany, solid brass zips, and a canvas lining that wipes clean. Sized for a carry-on and a two-night escape.

name: Halo Pendant
tagline: A single freshwater pearl on a fine chain.
description: One luminous freshwater pearl, hand-knotted on a 45cm chain of 18k gold vermeil. The clasp is small and hidden, so the pendant appears to float. A quiet piece that works with everything.
